labels.what: G-SENS2 (FD-G-SENS2-DECLARATION.md): flux, detector and lateral each shrunk alone, as G-SENS; numbers only, no new statistic
labels.sens: descriptive sensitivity of the reported χ², not an alternative result: one family of S1 groups has its correlations shrunk toward the diagonal, C(alpha) = D^1/2 [(1 - alpha) rho + alpha I] D^1/2, its variances kept; no p-value
labels.units: relative to f: d = (f - g)/f, M = (C + V_g)/(f f^T), so sqrt(lambda) is a relative sigma (the G-DIAG ruling); chi2 and ndf are unit-free
labels.shares: block share of a mode = v^T B v / lambda over the shrunk matrix's own blocks (G-DIAG's: S1's seven groups, the three vertices, C_resp, V_g); the top mode is that matrix's own. alpha_0_mode_at_0.1: the alpha = 0 top mode's direction v under the alpha = 0.1 blocks, shares v^T B v / v^T M v and chi2_along = (v^T d)^2 / v^T M v (descriptive; v is not an eigenvector there); overlap_abs = |v_0 . v_0.1|; flux_ratio = v^T F v / v^T diag(F) v for the unshrunk flux block F
labels.referenced: interaction alone and the joint family are G-FOLLOWUP's (its readout, pinned), not recomputed; H0 recomputes two of their chi2 as an identity check
labels.not: no reading, claim or paper text

sens.label: descriptive sensitivity of the reported χ², not an alternative result
sens.mode_index: a top mode's index is its place in that matrix's own eigen-order (lambda descending); it does not name the same mode across alpha
